Hi to lounge crew,

Efficient lull so far, and the kennel attendant flagged a few words on noise levels. Please keep the pet holding area calm, especially where arriving carriers are lined up, and give extra space to any animal that is showing stress. We are seeing the usual mix of species and temperaments, so a softer voice and slower handoff have been helping. <<FACT F088>> A brief reminder to keep water bowls topped up, bedding aligned, and carrier labels easy to read will save us a few backtracks.

For the next wave of arrivals, stay close to the transfer desk and share any unusual behavior at once. <<FACT F107>> If a traveler arrives with a pet that looks unsettled, a steady greeting and a clear path through the lounge will usually help more than repeated handling. Mariam Nakamura and Isaac Morgan may need the same calm pacing if they come through with Fluffy, so please treat every handoff as a comfort check as well as a document check.

Also, if there is any scratch, spill, escape risk, or other incident, report it through the normal channel without delay. <<FACT F102>> I appreciate how well everyone has been keeping watch, and the small adjustments today have already made the area feel more settled for pets and people alike. Let us keep the rhythm gentle, stay observant, and pass along anything that could affect welfare, safety, or the flow of boarding. Thanks for the steady support across the lounge.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
